llm_response.reason: The site claims to sell well-known 'Brixton' brand products but lacks any real company identification, physical address, or business contact info, offering only a generic contact form. Privacy policy is vague and devoid of legal information. Noted SSL certificate issues, which are common in scam sites. Site uses psychological phrases such as '100% Secure Shopping' and 'Free Shipping Over $60' to build false trust. The site structure, sales tactics, and absence of legitimate business credentials fit the hallmarks of a fake online shopping scam. There is also likely misuse of the 'Brixton' trademark. All these details, with no evidence of a real company behind the website, support the scam determination.
